The US president's unpredictable messaging coincides with renewed diplomacy as **Iran** reviews Washington's response to Tehran's latest ceasefire proposal. **Trump** has also indicated an appetite for a prolonged conflict, sharing a pro-Israel think tank article advocating for economic warfare and military action against Iran. This week, **Trump** threatened renewed attacks but later agreed to give **Iran** time to return to negotiations.  The US president faces a strategic dilemma as he seeks a convincing victory in the conflict while also navigating potential economic consequences of escalating tensions.

recent_articles.title: Qatar-based British-Pakistani scientist develops AI eye scan for early dementia diagnosis - World - DAWN.COM
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Professor Rayaz Malik**, a British-Pakistani scientist based in Qatar, has developed an AI-powered eye scan using corneal confocal microscopy (CCM) that can detect dementia and diabetic nerve damage years before symptoms appear.  This technology, traditionally used to diagnose infections and abnormalities in the front surface of the eye, has been shown to identify microscopic nerve fibre damage associated with diseases such as diabetes, chemotherapy, inflammatory disorders, and infectious diseases. **Professor Malik** believes this could be particularly important for countries facing ageing populations and rising rates of neurological disease.  The technology's ability to detect early-stage cognitive decline could lead to more effective treatments and earlier interventions.

recent_articles.title: Five key takeaways from Democrats’ autopsy report on Kamala Harris’s loss | Kamala Harris News | Al Jazeera
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Democratic National Committee (DNC)** released its long-awaited autopsy report on why former Vice President Kamala Harris lost the 2024 presidential election. The report, riddled with factual errors and missing sections, failed to address key issues like the Biden administration's support for Israel during the Gaza war, which some analysts believe contributed to Harris's loss.  The report also criticized the White House for assigning Harris immigration responsibilities without adequate preparation and suggested that the campaign focused too heavily on defeating Trump instead of promoting Harris's own vision. The report was released in its unedited format despite acknowledging its shortcomings and did not include specific recommendations for future elections.

recent_articles.title: Israel deports foreign Gaza-bound flotilla activists after global outcry | Israel | The Guardian
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Israel** has deported all foreign activists seized from a Gaza-bound flotilla after global condemnation of their treatment in custody.  The **UK**, **Italy**, and the **European Council** have summoned Israeli diplomats for a formal dressing down, with many condemning the far-right national security minister, **Itamar Ben-Gvir**, for posting a video depicting activists being humiliated.  Human rights groups have documented widespread abuse of Palestinians in Israeli prisons, prompting criticism from within Israel and even from US officials who typically support Israel's policies. Greece also called for the immediate release of its nationals detained on the flotilla.

recent_articles.title: Hot weather on the cards during Eid as PMD predicts heatwave from May 25-31 - Pakistan - DAWN.COM
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Pakistan's** **Meteorological Department (PMD)** has issued a heatwave warning for the country from May 25 to May 31, with temperatures expected to reach 47-50°C in some areas. The federal government has declared a three-day public holiday from May 26-28 to allow citizens to stay safe during the extreme weather conditions. **The PMD** advises the public to take precautions against heatstroke and conserve water and electricity.

recent_articles.title: Ebola tensions rise as treatment centre torched in DR Congo’s Ituri | Ebola News | Al Jazeera
recent_articles.rephrased_article: Residents in Rwampara, DRC, set fire to a treatment facility after authorities refused to release the body of a man believed to have died from Ebola. The incident highlights deep mistrust and anger surrounding the response to the outbreak, fueled by traditional burial practices that clash with public health measures. **The World Health Organization (WHO)** has declared the outbreak a public health emergency of international concern, warning that violence and community distrust are hampering efforts to contain the disease.
